facts.fact: The ministry's ICT Hub Strategy 2019-2024 assigns an ICT Incubation responsibility to offer incubation facilities to start-ups, including office space and basic technology infrastructure, and lists a priority-2 project for 2022-2024 to build expertise in ICT business incubation.

note: as_of is the strategy's published date, 2019-01-01, as the passages give no event date.
